invariants.description: the vessels inflow reaches the constant outflow at steady state (v → 1e-4 m^3/s, 0.1%)
the vessel pressure settles at the imposed inlet pressure minus the resistive drop, u → P − R v = P − 1000 Pa (±1 Pa)
vessel volume balance: q(t) − q(0) = ∫(v − v_out) dt with v_out = 1e-4 (trapezoidal, 0.1%)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((va__q - va__q[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((va__v) - (1e-4))[1:] + ((va__v) - (1e-4))[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*max(1e-12, np.max(np.abs(va__q - va__q[0])))

bc_sweep.rationale: Inlet (arterial) pressures from about 40 to 120 mmHg (5000-16000 Pa). v is excluded: it is the flow the connected vessel supplies (a port input).
